title: Grandma June's Bath Book
subtitle: Grandma June reads by Grandpa's fishing headlamp, and in the bath with kitchen tongs. Jo has a gift idea.
end: Is the Paperwhite the right gift for your reader? Ads, Black Friday prices and the Kobo option: full review on Verdict Picks (acts39.blogspot.com).
style: Cozy holiday palette: deep blue winter nights, warm amber lamplight, soft lavender and cream.

art.prompt: Night in a small cozy bedroom with a patchwork quilt: June sits up in bed wearing an oversized old fishing headlamp strapped over her silver curls, its harsh white beam blasting across a thick paperback she holds at arm's length; she squints proudly; a moth circles in the beam and a tall stack of worn paperbacks with bookmarks leans on the nightstand. Comic, warm, deep blue shadows. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Grandma June has read in bed every night for sixty years.

art.prompt: A small old-fashioned bathroom with a clawfoot tub full of bubbles: June sits in the bath with bubbles up to her shoulders and a floral shower cap on, holding a paperback sealed inside a plastic freezer bag with long kitchen tongs, very pleased with her system; a second wavy, water-wrinkled paperback dries on the radiator; a paperback has just slipped and splashes into the bubbles. Slapstick, warm steamy light. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: My bath book. Freezer bag, kitchen tongs. Works fine!

art.prompt: Jo in her city apartment on a video call (the phone is out of frame), laughing with one hand over her mouth and her eyes soft with love, a small holiday string of lights and a mug of cocoa behind her. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Grandma, I know exactly what you're getting this year.

art.prompt: Vera stands confidently in soft blue light beside three floating generic unbranded e-readers with blank screens: a small plain black one, a slim black one glowing gently in the middle, and one with a softly colourful blank screen; she taps the slim black one in the middle like a teacher choosing the answer. Clean, hopeful. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Paperwhite: $199.99 at Target, Nov 13. TechRadar's pick for most people.
Mostly novels? Get the Kindle Paperwhite. It's our top pick.

art.prompt: Comedic triumphant close-up of Jo, glasses flashing, pumping her fist with a huge grin; behind her a cartoon daydream bubble shows an old fishing headlamp and a pair of kitchen tongs waving goodbye and walking off into a sunset. Bright, funny, sparkles. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Warm light for reading in bed. Waterproof for the bath.

art.prompt: Holiday evening in June's cozy living room with a small decorated tree and snow outside the window: June on the sofa has just unwrapped a small gift and holds a slim generic black e-reader with a blank screen in both hands, amazed, turning it over; Jo sits beside her with an arm around her shoulders, beaming; torn wrapping paper and ribbon in her lap. Warm amber light. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: Oh my. But where do the pages go?

art.prompt: The same old-fashioned bathroom with the clawfoot tub full of bubbles: June in her floral shower cap, bubbles up to her shoulders, proudly holds a slim generic black e-reader with a blank screen in one hand above the water, calling toward the closed door with a delighted grin; the kitchen tongs and the empty freezer bag lie retired on a little stool beside a rubber duck. Funny and sweet. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

Heartwarming night scene in June's bedroom: June sits up in bed under the patchwork quilt reading aloud from a slim generic e-reader whose soft warm amber glow lights both faces; Jo, in pajamas, is curled up beside her on top of the quilt listening like a little girl, eyes half closed and smiling; the old fishing headlamp hangs retired on the bedpost; snow falls past the window. Tender, golden. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames.

items.text: One more chapter, like when you were little?
